{{Quote|Where am I?''"<br />"''You are a guest of the Hutts. If you do not answer my questions about your two partners...we will not be so hospitable.|Obi-Wan Kenobi speaking to the guard.|<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />}}
This [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] guard''' working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lords on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
[[File:Nikto-Guard-Tortures-Kenobi-In-Chamber.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The guard looking at an incapacitated Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 57">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 57|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 57]]</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]]. The three first visited [[Pablo's pawnshop/Legends|Pablo's Pawnshop]], where Cad Bane injured the owner, [[Pablo/Legends|Pablo]]. Later, when attempting to board a vessel to escape the planet, Kenobi was double-crossed by Bane, and left lying on the ground while Bane and Eval left the planet. By that time, this particular guard had been notified of Bane's wounding Pablo, and easily knocked out a dazed Kenobi. The unconscious Jedi was brought to the [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Hutts' Palace]] to be interrogated, where this guard tortured him for information about the two other escapees.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />

[[File:NalHuttaNiktoEnforcer-FAE.png|thumb|right|125px|The guard while torturing Kenobi.]]
Kenobi willfully gave the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] the [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracker's]] frequency code in exchange for being released, however, once the Nikto got word from [[Unidentified Nikto pilot/Legends|another enforcer]] that the escaping ship had been shot down, he decided the deal was off, gave a hearty laugh, and turned his back on the disguised Jedi. After showing an interest in Kenobi's helmet, the guard soon became distracted. Upon realizing this, Kenobi freed himself, grabbed hold of the guard's staff, and used it against him. The guard was thrown against a control panel and onto the ground where he quickly lost consciousness as Kenobi looked on in disgust.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:GorgaBilbousa-FAE.png|thumb|left|200px|Two members of Nal Hutta's security force who wore the same uniform as this guard's.]]
This guard was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]], featuring [[Color/Legends|reddish-brown]] skin, and yellow eyes. The guard was a member of Nal Hutta's security force, and seemed to hold a pristine position, having command over at least two [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], though he was abusive of his power. It was a common sight to find members of the security force, who were also Nikto, attacking low-life criminals, such as the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who lived on the planet. It can be inferred that this guard did the same. The guard was also deceiving, tricking Kenobi into giving him information, though the Nikto was eventually stunned by Kenobi a few moments following.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />

==Equipment==
All known Nikto who worked for the Hutt crime lords wore the standard uniform made up of all black attire. This particular guard also wore a helmet and carried a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] of some sort, which doubled as a staff used for interrogation. Many Nikto in employment of the Hutts were also able to pilot [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 Starhoppers]], presumably to shoot down enemies of the Hutt families.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />

==Behind the scenes==
This guard first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode, [[Friends and Enemies]], which was released in [[2012]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />
